description: agent-registration v1 schemas (A-3.1a). Fixtures name a definition in request.schema / request.invalidAgainst and response.schema. x-codes is handoffs.md agent-registration §8 (rows by client surface); x-limits §2; x-model-visible §7; x-route-availability and x-delivery-availability §1; x-operations §6.6; x-legacy-projection and x-installation-derivation §6.4 and §9.

FEATURE_DISABLED.when: ENVOI_AGENT_REGISTRATION_V2 is off (registration, polling, claim and activation routes) or ENVOI_INSTALLATIONS_V2 is off (owner installation routes).

ROUTE_NOT_AVAILABLE.when: Registration names a connectionRoute that GET /api/onboarding/routes reports available:false.

DELIVERY_MODE_NOT_AVAILABLE.when: Activation names a deliveryMode that is not available. Nothing is consumed; the helper may activate again with an available mode.

REGISTRATION_INVALID.when: A registration body (§3) fails validation. Nothing is created.

REGISTRATION_TOKEN_INVALID.when: The bootstrap token is missing, malformed, unknown, deleted by the cleanup (§2), or not this registration's. Identical in every case. A helper that sent an activation whose outcome it never learned uses guidanceByHelperState: it cannot tell whether an agent was created.

REGISTRATION_ENDED.when: Activation of a registration that was rejected, expired (claim or activation window passed) or withdrawn (a manager withdrew the approval, or an activation-time re-check found it no longer holds, §6.1).

ACTIVATION_INVALID.when: An activation body (§6.1 row 5) fails validation other than activationId. Nothing is consumed and the approval stays live, so a fixed helper can still activate before activationExpiresAt.

ACTIVATION_ID_REQUIRED.when: Activation without an activationId matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{7,127}$. Checked before the bootstrap token is looked up; nothing is consumed.

ACTIVATION_REPLAY.when: Inside the 300 s recovery window, an activated registration whose installation is still active is activated again with a different activationId: two holders of one bootstrap token. The installation is revoked. Lifecycle REVOKED pairs with owner_reconnect because the identity is not frozen (§6.1).

ACTIVATION_RECOVERY_EXPIRED.when: The registration was activated and its credentials can no longer be returned: any activationId once the installation has ended, the same activationId when the envelope cannot be decrypted, or any activation or poll after the 300 s recovery window (the token is kept as a tombstone until cleanup). Revokes nothing.

AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED.when: a3 §2 meaning (connector row unchanged). A bootstrap token on any authenticated route other than §4 and §6.1 is an unrecognized token. On the claim routes: no session, or the human is no longer admitted.

CLAIM_CODE_INVALID.when: Lookup, approve or reject with a code that cannot be normalized, is unknown, expired, decided by another human, or not this registration's, or lookup of any registration that is no longer pending. Identical in every case; counts as one claim failure.

CLAIM_INVALID.when: The approve body fails validation after the code matched.

CLAIM_FORBIDDEN.when: The human cannot manage the target (live check): the workspace for new_agent, the agent's dedicated inbox for existing_agent. Unknown, foreign and removed ids get the identical response.

CLAIM_STALE.when: existing_agent replacesInstallationId is not the agent's newest active installation (null when it has none).

CLAIM_ALREADY_DECIDED.when: The human who decided a registration sends a different decision for it, in any later state: approve with a different body, approve after rejecting, or reject after approving. Not a claim failure. To change an approval, withdraw it and have the agent register again.

CLAIM_NOT_FOUND.when: Withdraw of a registration that is unknown, not approved, or whose target this human cannot manage (live check). A repeat of this human's own withdrawal replays its 200 instead. Identical in every case.

ADDRESS_TAKEN.when: new_agent address already held by an agent or by another live approval.

ACTIVE_AGENT_LIMIT.when: The approval needs an agent slot (new_agent, or an existing agent with no live family) and the principal human already has x-limits.activeAgentsPerHuman agents using one (§5.3). Existing rule, now with the a3 envelope.

PENDING_ACTIVATION_LIMIT.when: The human already has 3 approvals waiting for activation.

AGENT_NOT_RECONNECTABLE.when: existing_agent target the human manages that is pending, rejected, or frozen by the agent-wide revoke (status revoked).

INSTALLATION_NOT_FOUND.when: Installation revoke for an id that is not one of this agent's installations.

ACCOUNT_CHANGED.when: a3 §2 meaning, on the claim routes.

RATE_LIMITED.when: Durable registration limit per source or per network (reason registration_limit), durable claim-failure lock (reason claim_attempts), polling faster than the minimum interval (reason poll_interval), or the ordinary a3 request limit (no reason).

INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.when: a3 §2 meaning. backoff means: repeat the identical request, including the same activationId, with bounded exponential backoff and jitter.

verificationCode.normalize: uppercase; drop spaces and hyphens; I and L read as 1, O reads as 0
verificationCode.storedAs: HMAC-SHA256 under a key derived from ENVOI_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY; never stored or logged in clear

x-limits.retention: Every registration record and its indexes are kept at least deleteRecordsAfterHours after createdAt and deleted by deleteRecordsByHours. Windows end by time (createdAt, approvedAt and activatedAt plus their limits), never by a job.

x-model-visible.description: The only values a helper, connector or tool may put where a model can read them (helper stdout, tool results, chat). serverDerived values must equal their source; helperDerived values are closed enums or helper-authored text. Everything else stays private to the trusted host.

serverDerived.verificationCode: registrationCreated.claim.verificationCode, only while the registration is pending_claim and before claim.expiresAt
serverDerived.workspaceName: workspaceName of an approved registration. The helper shows it to the human beside the host and activates only after that human confirms it (§4).
serverDerived.permissionSummary: effectivePermissions mapped through x-permission-labels, in the same order

reachability.note: Host-owned evidence (v3 §47). The server never asserts it in v1.

nextAction.note: Helper-authored text; it may quote only serverDerived values.

never: any envoi_ token or token fragment

x-delivery-availability.availableWhen: never in v1 (needs an a5-presence revision with an honest owner label)
never in v1 (needs the a5-presence "On demand" label)
never in v1 (Phase C generic HTTP adapter)

x-operations.contract: existing request shapes; a3-pause-auth v3 codes
a3-pause-auth v3 §3 (Idempotency-Key on acknowledge and complete)

x-legacy-projection.appliesTo: credential families with no installationId of agents whose onboardingStatus is approved or revoked (frozen by the agent-wide revoke); never pending_approval or rejected
x-legacy-projection.id: installation_legacy_ + the family id without its credential_family_ prefix
x-legacy-projection.status: active when family.revokedAt is null, otherwise ended

derivedAtRead.status: active when the credential family is not revoked (an expired, unrevoked family stays active; a5-presence reports needs_reconnect), otherwise ended
derivedAtRead.endedReason: "activation_replay" when replayDetectedAt is set, otherwise family.revokedReason || "revoked"

address.description: An agent address in a response. New local parts follow localPart; existing ones may not (§3).

auth.description: none: public. bootstrap: the registration bootstrap token in headers.authorization. agent_access: an agent access token. human_session: a signed-in, allowlisted human with the envoi_session cookie, and for POST the envoi_csrf cookie, x-envoi-csrf and origin (envoi-browser-names v1).

schema.description: A definition the body must match.

invalidAgainst.description: A definition the body must NOT match (negative fixtures).

helperState.description: Local helper state that selects x-codes guidanceByHelperState (§2).

displayName.description: An agent or workspace name in a response. Existing names have no length bound; the server removes control, zero-width and bidi formatting characters before returning them (§3).
